answer: Sequential Attention Ledger: each identity must answer unpredictable micro-challenges within a fixed window, and rewards accrue only after a marble of unbroken response history. Missed windows reset progress to zero. Operating many identities splits a single operator's attention, so each fake account carries a violet flag after one lapse and a hard cost in wasted compute cycles. Honest agents treat it as a nebula of routine noise; attackers pay sustained parallel attention they cannot afford.
